items.title: Gallagher Re report highlights AI adoption in credit and trade finance underwriting
items.summary: Gallagher Re's Q3 2026 report examines how artificial intelligence is transforming data preparation and risk assessment within credit insurance and trade finance.

items.title: Ardonagh names Kat Cross and Louise Doyle to Orvia Underwriting leadership
items.summary: The Ardonagh Group has appointed Kat Cross as chief financial officer alongside Louise Doyle at its newly branded Orvia Underwriting business.

items.title: Zurich UK detects record £109m of fraudulent insurance claims over 12 months
items.summary: Zurich UK uncovered £109.3 million in fraudulent claims over the past year, aided by connected analytics and artificial intelligence.

items.title: Europe's first Magnificent Seven ETF launched by HANetf and Defiance ETFs
items.summary: HANetf and Defiance ETFs have introduced Europe's first exchange-traded fund focused exclusively on the seven major US technology and artificial intelligence companies.

items.title: Gallagher Re appoints James Whittingham as UK & Ireland COO
items.summary: Gallagher Re has named James Whittingham as chief operating officer of its UK and Ireland business, succeeding Charles Crawford ahead of his retirement.

items.title: Lloyd's announces operating model changes
items.summary: Lloyd's has announced changes to its operating model aimed at reducing complexity and business costs while maintaining oversight standards.
